methods.label: SSS across a diagonal
methods.explanation: Draw \(AC\). By SSS, \(\triangle ABC\cong\triangle CDA\). The corresponding angles \(\angle B\) and \(\angle D\) are equal, so \(\angle D=70^\circ\).
